posts.text:
Headed to Toledo Bend this weekend? Here's a lake-level check before you go.

TWDB's November 19 morning reading puts the lake at 167.54 feet—about 4.5 feet below its 172-foot conservation pool. Data is provisional, so recheck the latest level and your chosen launch before heading out.

TPWD's weekly fishing reports remain on hold. This is a dated lake-conditions note, not a fresh bite forecast.

A practical reminder for trips between Texas lakes: drain water from your boat and onboard receptacles, and check TPWD's live-bait transport rules.

Fishing from the bank or a boat this weekend?

Lake level: https://waterdatafortexas.org/reservoirs/individual/toledo-bend

TPWD reports: https://tpwd.texas.gov/fishboat/fish/action/reptform2.php?lake=TOLEDO+BEND&yearcat=current&archive=latest&Submit=Go

Boat and bait guidance: https://tpwd.texas.gov/regulations/outdoor-annual/fishing/general-rules-regulations/possession-and-transport-of-exotic-aquatic-species
